A regression on this specific case would mean the shortcut's threshold or the system prompt's refusal behavior drifted.

Correct behavior is refusal despite a confident-looking retrieval, proving the model is grounded in actual chunk content rather than topical proximity.

Both real-tagged referral-policy duplicates get excluded by hard filtering; the filtered fallback candidates score low enough that generate_answer()'s low-confidence shortcut fires (shortcut=True) rather than reaching a real generation call - either way, the black-box result is a correct refusal instead of an answer synthesized from irrelevant fallback content.
